description: Use this when an agent needs weather with Data BitScore. kind="intuitive" (default): current conditions; kind="stats": 7-day forecast; kind="pro": route/multi-place go/no-go; kind="signals": severe alerts. Pass location, zip, or lat+lon (locations/origin/destination for pro; state for signals). Not for navigation. Returns JSON `data` with attribution. Kinds: intuitive (3 sats or $0.002 USDC), stats (17 sats or $0.01 USDC), pro (33 sats or $0.02 USDC), signals (33 sats or $0.02 USDC). Pay: L402 (`l402_credential`), x402 (`x402_payment`), or `credit_token` (https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay, bittuitive://guide/pricing). Info only; not financial/legal advice; no warranty.
